units: <cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Genesis 24:20">Targ. Y. II, Gen. XXIV, 20</cite> (h. text <he>מהר</he>).—
Targ. Ps. LXX, 2 זְרֵיז ed. (Ms. זָ׳; h. text חוש); a. e.—Part. Pe. זָרִיז, Pa. מְזָרֵז; pl. זְרִיזִין, זַרְזִין, מְזָרְזִין.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 9:8">Targ. Y. I Num. IX, 8</cite>, <cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Numbers 9:8">Targ. Y. II, Num. IX, 8</cite>, opp. <cite ref="M03027"><he>מתון</he></cite>; v. also <cite ref="G00703"><he>זָרִיז</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Yevamot 102b:12">Yeb. 102ᵇ</cite> (expl. <he>יחליץ</he>, <cite ref="Isaiah 58:11">Is. LVIII, 11</cite>) <he>זָרוּזֵי גרמי</he> it means quickening the bones. Cant. R. to II, 10 <he>זָרוֹזִי גרמיך</he> (not <cite ref="G00683"><he>זרורזי</he></cite>) make thyself ready; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 15:1">Pesik. R. s. 15</cite> <he>זָרְזִי</he>.

senses.gloss: (cmp. זֵיר, אָזַר) to tie around, gird, arm; to harness, saddle.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 38:3">Targ. Job XXXVIII, 3</cite> <he>זָרֵיז</he> Ms. (ed. <cite ref="G00704"><he>זְרֵיז</he></cite>, <cite ref="G00686"><he>זְרַז</he></cite>).
Targ. O. Ex. XXIX, 9; a. fr.—Part. pass. מְזָרַז, pl. מְזַרְזִין, מְזַרְזַיָּא armed.
Targ. Is. XV, 4; a. fr.—Yeb. l. c. (ref. to וחלצה, Deut. XXV, 9) ואימא זָרוּזֵי הוא may I not say, it means tying on?

senses.gloss: to strengthen one’s self (so as not to give way to emotion).
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 43:31">Targ. Y. Gen. XLIII, 31</cite>.

Targ. Prov. XXX, 31, v. זַרְכֵּל.—Sifré Num. s. 157 אין החלצו אלא אִיזְדָּרְזוּ heḥal’tsu (Num. XXXI, 3) means, be armed; Yalk. ib. 785 הִזְדָּרְזוּ (Hebr.).
